dedupe_keys.name: homesense multisensor dutch social housing energy and activity

description: HOMESENSE contains harmonized sensor observations for 11 pseudonymized social-rental dwellings in Limburg, the Netherlands. The Zenodo record is open under CC BY 4.0 and lists one CSV per dwelling, example notebooks and a release-preparation script. Coverage is 366 local calendar days from November 2024 to November 2025 on a common ten-minute publication grid. Variables include indoor conditions, radiator-valve telemetry, appliance and whole-home electricity, grid import and export, activity sensors, gas where available and Maastricht weather. These observations can calibrate occupant schedules for digital-twin and capacity-planning simulations with a building energy model such as model-energyplus. A caveat is that sensor availability varies between homes and the release marks values as observed, interpolated, reset-imputed or missing. Raw household records and addresses are withheld, so the release cannot recreate every original signal or locate a dwelling precisely. I read the own metadata and manifest, without downloading the approximately 788 MB release, checking sensor calibration or running the notebooks.
